name: audit2f cipher update arrays join through Buffer.concat
source: import * as crypto from "node:crypto"; function main(): void { const key = Buffer.alloc(32, 1), iv = Buffer.alloc(16, 2); const c = crypto.createCipheriv("aes-256-cbc", key, iv); const a: Buffer = c.update("secret message", "utf8"); const b: Buffer = c.final(); console.log(Buffer.concat([a, b]).toString("hex")); }
